content: BullMQ monitoring: failed jobs are a normal lifecycle state - worker keeps running, no process death/HTTP 500, so silent failures are the default risk; BullMQ has no built-in DLQ, the failed set is the closest equivalent; alert on failure count/rate, stalled jobs, backlog growth, worker heartbeat; listen to QueueEvents global:failed or poll getFailed(); retention via removeOnFail. 5xx spike alerting: alert on sustained error rate / multi-window error-budget burn (Google SRE: page at 1h burn>14.4x, ticket at 6h burn>6x) rather than raw instantaneous thresholds; break down by route/release/upstream. Quota exhaustion: track remaining provider budget as a first-class metric with threshold alerts near daily allowance.
